record.original_question: Suppose a graph G satisfies |E(H)| <= c|V(H)|^2 for every subgraph H of G. Does it follow that lambda(G) <= 2c|V(G)|? More generally, what bound should replace this when the exponent 2 is replaced by another constant less than 2?

evidence.quote: Problem 1 (Guiduli [78]). If for a graph G, |E(H)| ≤ c · |V(H)|^2 holds for all subgraph H of G, does it follows that λ(G) ≤ 2c · |V (G)| ? What can be said if the exponent of 2 is replaced by some other constant less than 2 ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a finite simple graph with vertex set $V(G)$ and edge set $E(G)$, and let $\lambda(G)$ denote the largest eigenvalue (spectral radius) of the adjacency matrix of $G$. Fix a constant $c>0$ and suppose that $G$ has the hereditary edge-density property
$$|E(H)| \le c\,|V(H)|^{2}$$
for every (not necessarily induced) subgraph $H$ of $G$.

(a) Does it follow that $\lambda(G) \le 2c\,|V(G)|$?

(b) More generally, suppose that for some constant $\alpha$ with $1<\alpha<2$ and some constant $c>0$, the graph $G$ satisfies $|E(H)| \le c\,|V(H)|^{\alpha}$ for every subgraph $H$ of $G$. Determine the best possible upper bound on $\lambda(G)$ as a function of $c$, $\alpha$, and $|V(G)|$ that replaces the bound $2c\,|V(G)|$ in this regime.
artifact.status_search_result: A direct web search did not return a definitive resolution of Guiduli's problem connecting hereditary edge-density bounds of the form |E(H)| ≤ c|V(H)|^2 to the spectral radius bound λ(G) ≤ 2c|V(G)|, nor a published answer for the analogous question with exponent less than 2. The problem appears in surveys of open problems in spectral graph theory without an attributed solution, so its status is treated as unknown here.

status_evidence.title: A bound on the spectral radius of graphs with e edges
status_evidence.snippet: Classical bound relating spectral radius to number of edges, but does not address the hereditary version posed by Guiduli.
status_evidence.claim: Related spectral-radius/edge-count bounds exist but the specific hereditary problem is not resolved in the located sources.

status_evidence.title: Spectral Extrema for Graphs: The Zarankiewicz Problem
status_evidence.snippet: Guiduli's work on spectral extrema for K_{t,s}-free graphs and related forbidden-subgraph problems.
status_evidence.claim: Guiduli's published work addresses related forbidden-subgraph spectral extrema, but the hereditary edge-bound question stated here is not resolved there.
